headline: Turner's two-run single in 10th walks off Braves
recap: The Phillies beat the Atlanta Braves 3-2 in 10 innings at Citizens Bank Park. Atlanta had taken a 2-1 lead in the top of the tenth when Nacho Alvarez Jr. singled home the automatic runner off Matt Strahm. In the bottom half, Nick Castellanos was hit by a pitch and Bryson Stott singled to put runners at first and third, and after two strikeouts Trea Turner lined a single to right field that scored both Alec Bohm and Castellanos for the walk-off win.

Phillies starter Cristopher Sanchez allowed one run on seven hits over seven innings, striking out eight without a walk. Braves starter Chris Sale matched him for six innings, giving up one run on three hits with nine strikeouts, undone by a third-inning solo home run from Weston Wilson. Atlanta tied it in the sixth on a Jurickson Profar leadoff double and a Matt Olson double.

Strahm picked up the win despite allowing Atlanta's go-ahead run in the tenth. Hunter Stratton took the loss and Dylan Dodd was charged with a blown save after inheriting two runners in the bottom half. Turner finished 3-for-4 with two doubles, a walk and the deciding two-run single.
